mechanism: Nicotine induces CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein, potentially reducing dabigatran plasma concentrations and anticoagulant efficacy; nicotine also increases thrombotic risk through platelet aggregation and prothrombotic effects.
action: Monitor for signs of thromboembolism; counsel patients on smoking cessation; consider INR monitoring if applicable or alternative anticoagulation strategy if heavy smoking occurs.
